mapper.select: SELECT ip.inquiry_id, ip.user_idx, u.nickname, ip.title, ip.content, ip.category, ip.is_private, ip.status, ip.view_count, ip.created_at, ip.updated_at FROM INQUIRY_POST ip LEFT JOIN USERS u ON ip.user_idx = u.user_idx WHERE ip.inquiry_id = #{inquiryId}

SELECT ia.answer_id, ia.inquiry_id, ia.admin_user_idx, u.nickname, ia.content, ia.created_at, ia.updated_at FROM INQUIRY_ANSWER ia LEFT JOIN USERS u ON ia.admin_user_idx = u.user_idx WHERE ia.inquiry_id = #{inquiryId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO INQUIRY_POST (user_idx, title, content, category, is_private, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userIdx}, #{title}, #{content}, #{category}, #{isPrivate}, 'PENDING', NOW(), NOW())
INSERT INTO INQUIRY_ANSWER (inquiry_id, admin_user_idx, content, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{inquiryId}, #{adminUserIdx}, #{content}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE INQUIRY_POST SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, category = #{category}, is_private = #{isPrivate}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE inquiry_id = #{inquiryId}
